Public H100 SXM 80 GB reference rate and hardware specification. AP-IN-1 launch announcement confirms H100 80 GB HBM3 hardware in India, but exact host price, CPU/RAM allocation and network-volume availability there are not independently quoted. Standard network storage under 1 TB is $0.07/GB/month; not a guarantee that it is attachable in AP-IN-1. No ingress/egress fees. Public IPv4 pricing not verified.

Single-GPU public rate and specification. India region exists but documentation explicitly says not every instance type is available in every region. Regional SKU association, persistent-filesystem price and public-IP/egress meters require a live authenticated quote. Published root SSD is not counted as persistent storage after instance termination.
